purpose: Phase-6C population-response STATE vocabulary + composition->state thresholds. A SCHEMATIC virtual cell population derived from the Phase-6B single-cell apoptosis trajectory. Fractions are normalized [0,1] simulation values - NEVER real cell counts, density, cellularity, or tumour geometry. The simulator STOPS at population composition; no tumour / clinical / survival outcome is represented.

fraction_semantics.conservation_invariant: living_fraction + apoptotic_fraction == 1.0 (always; no disappearing, duplicated, or spontaneously growing cells)
fraction_semantics.apoptotic_monotonic: apoptotic_fraction is non-decreasing; committed apoptotic cells never resurrect
fraction_semantics.sub_classification: adapted_fraction and recovered_fraction are sub-fractions of the LIVING pool (adapted + recovered <= living_fraction)
fraction_semantics.cumulative_apoptosis: equals apoptotic_fraction (kept explicit for the timeline / history)

population_states.description: No meaningful stress; apoptotic fraction negligible.
Detectable schematic stress; apoptotic fraction still negligible.
Surviving cells adapt; apoptotic fraction still low.
A minority sub-population has become apoptotic; living cells clearly dominant.
Apoptotic and living fractions are comparable.
Apoptotic fraction is the majority and still rising.
Apoptotic fraction past the dominance threshold (irreversible).
Apoptotic fraction has reached its ceiling and stopped changing (irreversible terminal equilibrium).

composition_thresholds.thresholds_basis: SCHEMATIC ordinal boundaries on the normalized apoptotic fraction (and schematic stress/adaptation signals). NOT measured cellularity or an apoptotic index; no biological % of cells is claimed.

stop_boundary: population composition (living / apoptotic / adapted / recovered fractions + population state)
